input.free_text_description: This system is a messaging platform that serves Customer roles. The platform provides capabilities for order, stock. Secondary concerns include e-commerce functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Customer, I want to add items to my cart and complete a purchase, so that I can buy products conveniently.
As a Customer, I want to interact with transaction functionality, so that I can accomplish my transaction-related tasks.
As a Customer, I want to use stock capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Customer, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
As a Customer, I want to view a summary of my recent activity, so that I can track my progress.
